test_title: PYST 20: Selection Post (GraduatiOn Level) - English (Held On 9 Feb 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

The audience was making fun of the speaker.

options.text: The speaker was being made fun of by the audience.
The speaker was made fun of by the audience.
The speaker is being made fun of by the audience.
The speaker has been made fun of by the audience.

solution:
The correct answer is **'The speaker was being made fun of by the audience.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in **active voice.** As per the question, we have to change it into **passive voice.**
 
• The structure of the given sentence is as follows:
 
 
• **Subject + was + past participle + Object (Active voice)**
 
• **Subject (objective case) + was + being + past participle + by Object (subjective case) (Passive voice)**
 
 
 
• Example: 
 
 
• *She was cooking dinner. (Active voice)*
 
• *Dinner was being cooked by her. (Passive voice)*
 
 
 
• The **subject **of the given sentence is ‘**the audience**’.
 
• The **object** of the given subject is **‘the speaker’.**
 
• The subject will be put in place of the object and the object will be put in place of the subject. 
 
• **'was making fun'** will be changed to '**was being made fun of'**.

 

**Correct sentence**__*** - **The speaker was being made fun of by the audience.*
